model_output.verdict: An experienced elementary teacher whose classroom results and school leadership are easy to see.
write_up: This is a strong teaching resume! Your work at Lincoln Heights shows classroom teaching, grade-level leadership, curriculum training and an after-school club, with enough detail to see how each fits into your job.

The reading growth line is the standout: it gives a district assessment, a starting point and a later result over three years. Your certification and English Language Learner endorsement also make your qualifications easy to find.

I’d leave most of this alone and add what you contributed to the positive behavior support committee at Whitman. Your resume is ready to send for elementary teaching roles; competition for individual openings will matter too.
